source: Unmodified transaction traces from the locally retained BSC Extended block captures (erc20/balances/out/top50-full-holder-blocks, producer version 5). Each fixture keeps the block header, hash and number and one TransactionTrace; other transactions and block-level records are omitted.
extraction: Decoded with prost from the captured <height>.pb, filtered transaction_traces to the listed index, re-encoded. No field edits.
configuration: tests/fixtures/bsc-aave-v3-epochs.json (Aave V3 BNB Pool 0x6807dc923806fE8Fd134338EABCA509979a7e0cB, aBnbUSDT 0xa9251ca9DE909CB71783723713B21E4233fbf1B1, aBnbUSDC 0x00901a076785e0906d1028c7d6372d247bec7d61); reserves mapping slot 52 and aToken slots 0x34/0x35/0x36 observed from Keccak preimages in the saved blocks and consistent with the pinned source declaration order.
scope: Saved-data tests of the Rust map (issue #13). Not packaged WASM execution, not RPC qualification; runtime code hashes and activation blocks remain unbound.

cases.demonstrates: aBnbUSDT holder burns to a known zero (two writes to the same _userState word: index then balance); Pool writes the USDT reserve index/rate word twice and the clock word once; scaled total supply falls

aBnbUSDT holder scaled balance decreases by a withdrawal; the reserve index written here equals rayMul(linearInterest(previous rate, previous timestamp, block timestamp), previous index), the conformance oracle
one holder touches both aBnbUSDT and aBnbUSDC in one transaction; both reserves' index/rate/clock words update (USDC index written three times); rows stay separated per market
